…'t fail the live-session guard open

Root cause: otherLiveSessionsHere (tidy-primary.ts) and isCheckoutOccupied /
contendingLiveSessions (presence.ts) each decided "same checkout" with
`path.resolve(a) !== path.resolve(b)`, which normalizes separators and `.`/`..`
segments but never folds case. On Windows the same folder can be spelled two
ways that differ only in case (VS Code's fsPath lower-cases the drive letter,
git prints its own spelling) or via an 8.3 short name / subst drive / junction.
A spelling mismatch makes otherLiveSessionsHere read as "nobody here" — a
clean read, not a corrupt/unreadable one — so it returns `[]` instead of the
fail-closed `null`, and tidy-primary's destructive discard proceeds exactly in
the case the guard exists to catch (constitution invariant 2: a missing or
errored witness must fail closed; this wasn't erroring, it was silently wrong).

Fix: add `sameCheckout(a, b, deps?)` to presence.ts — canonicalizes both sides
via `fs.realpathSync.native` (folds short names/junctions/subst drives and,
where the OS does, drive-letter case), falls back to `path.resolve` when a
side can't be realpath'd, then case-folds on `win32` only. `platform` and
`realpathNative` are injectable so the win32 branch and a table of Windows
spellings are testable from Linux CI via `path.win32`, per the issue's
suggested design. All three call sites now go through this one function
instead of their own `path.resolve` compare.

Tests: new `sameCheckout` describe block in presence.test.ts — a win32
spelling table (drive-letter case, slash style, trailing separator) all
compare equal, a genuinely different folder does not, POSIX stays
case-sensitive, realpath-success (symlink) and realpath-failure (nonexistent
path) fallback are both covered. Verified these 7 tests fail with
`sameCheckout is not a function` against the pre-fix lib/ (git stash of the
lib changes only, tests re-run, then restored) and pass against head.

Triggered by: #2403
